definitions.explanation: The combined process of an aircraft departing from and arriving at the ground. A suru-verb that can also describe the act of taking off and landing.

examples.japanese: {離着陸|りちゃくりく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧。
⟦{強風|きょうふう}→強風：15269_kyoufuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{離着陸|りちゃくりく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れている→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: Takeoffs and landings are delayed due to strong winds.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{三百回|さんびゃっかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{離着陸|りちゃくりく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: About 300 takeoffs and landings take place at this airport every day.

notes:
A compound abbreviation combining ⟦{離陸|りりく}→離陸：05981_ririku⟧ (takeoff) and ⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧ (landing) into a single word. The {離|り} from ⟦{離陸|りりく}→離陸：05981_ririku⟧ is placed before ⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧.

USAGE:
Common in aviation, airport announcements, news reports, and discussions about air travel. Can function as a suru-verb: {離着陸|りちゃくりく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {離着陸|りちゃくりく}⟦{回数|かいすう}→回数：00139_kaisuu⟧ — number of takeoffs and landings
- {離着陸|りちゃくりく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧ — takeoffs and landings are delayed
- {離着陸|りちゃくりく}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ — takeoff and landing prohibited
- ⟦{垂直|すいちょく}→垂直：05446_suichoku⟧{離着陸|りちゃくりく} — vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{離陸|りりく}→離陸：05981_ririku⟧ — takeoff (only)
- ⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧ — landing (only)
- ⟦{発着|はっちゃく}→発着：06808_hacchaku⟧ — departure and arrival; broader term used for trains, ships, and planes
